You are an expert in analyzing logs of test execution script and dockerfile construction.  
Your task is to verify whether the target tests have been executed correctly and, if not, diagnose the issues.
Background: To run the target test files of a given repository, we create a Dockerfile and an eval script. We plan to invoke the eval script inside the container built by that Dockerfile.

You will:
1. Analyze the log of test execution to check if the target tests were executed and whether they passed.
2. If the tests did not run correctly, determine whether the issue is related to:
   - The **Dockerfile** (environment setup issues)
   - The **evaluation script** (test execution issues)
   - Missing information that needs to be collected

3. Based on your analysis, provide **clear guidance** to the appropriate agent:
   - `write_dockerfile_agent`
   - `write_eval_script_agent`
   - `context_retrieval_agent`

Your findings and recommendations must be structured in a JSON format, ensuring efficient collaboration with other agents.

Target repository name: langflow-ai/langflow
Commit SHA: 2a95b52e06769d70fd9f0671cfcc6734ee41f0ef
Version: 1.1
Target test files:
src/backend/tests/unit/components/models/test_baidu_qianfan.py

The current dockerfile used to setup environemnt:
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install essential system packages and dependencies
RUN apt update && apt install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    python3.10 \
    python3.10-venv \
    python3.10-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    locales-all \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Setup python3 alias to python3.10
RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.10 1

# Clone the repository first into /testbed
RUN git clone https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow.git /testbed/
WORKDIR /testbed/
RUN git reset --hard 2a95b52e06769d70fd9f0671cfcc6734ee41f0ef

# Create virtual environment inside /testbed after cloning
RUN python3 -m venv venv

ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/testbed/venv
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

# Upgrade pip, setuptools, and wheel inside the venv
RUN pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install langflow-base and crewai separately to isolate dependency conflicts
RUN pip install langflow-base==0.1.1 || true
RUN pip install crewai~=0.86.0 || true

# Install other dependencies excluding langflow-base and crewai to avoid conflicts

    beautifulsoup4==4.12.3 \

# Install make utility
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y make && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Ensure virtual environment is activated on shell startup

The current eval script (omit test patch to decrease length) used to run tests:
#!/bin/bash
set -uxo pipefail
cd /testbed
git checkout 2a95b52e06769d70fd9f0671cfcc6734ee41f0ef 

git apply -v - <<'EOF_114329324912'
[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]
EOF_114329324912

# Activate virtual environment
source /testbed/venv/bin/activate

# Run only the specified test file using pytest with concise output of test file and result
pytest --tb=short --disable-warnings -q src/backend/tests/unit/components/models/test_baidu_qianfan.py
rc=$?

echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc"

# Cleanup/reset the patched test file to original
git checkout 2a95b52e06769d70fd9f0671cfcc6734ee41f0ef src/backend/tests/unit/components/models/test_baidu_qianfan.py
